description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing a shopping cart with persistence in localStorage. It includes functions to add, remove, and update items in the cart, as well as computing total items and total price.

methods.name: CartProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides cart state and manipulation functions via context, with persistence.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, increasing quantity if product already exists.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product, ensuring minimum quantity of 1.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
